answers.core:
Providing these getters makes the list of tweens returned by `get_processed_tweens()` more useful.

The `SceneTreeTween` already has a `loops` member that could be used to implement this functionality, there just isn't any way to access it from GDScript.
answers.workaround: The simplest workaround (as [suggested by](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/5141#issuecomment-1211282860) @SilencedPerson) is to manually add metadata to infinitely looping tweens.

title: SceneTreeTween: Add a way to identify looping tweens
